newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAL plans aviation consulting firm targeting Asia.
newsitem.headline: JAL plans aviation consulting firm targeting Asia.

text.p: Japan Airlines Co Ltd (JAL) said on Thursday that it would form a consulting company focusing on aviation-related projects in the Asia-Pacific region.
JAL Aviation Consulting Co Ltd, to be capitalised at 11.5 million yen, would be set up in Tokyo later this month by JAL and its group companies, JAL said in a statement.
The firms, which until now have been involved individually in facility modernisation and airport development programmes, would pool their knowhow in the new company, it said.
JAL said the new firm would seek business opportunities primarily in Southeast Asia, China and other countries in the Asia-Pacific region.
The International Air Transport Association (IATA) says air passenger traffic in the Asia-Pacific region is growing faster than in any other part of the world, JAL said.
It said about 30 major aviation-related projects were currently underway in the region, excluding Japan.
